newsitem.title: USA: Tax bill calls for 22 new empowerment zones.
newsitem.headline: Tax bill calls for 22 new empowerment zones.

text.p: U.S. tax legislation agreed to by congressional leaders and the White House would create 22 new urban empowerment zones -- two that would provide wage credits and 20 that would not, a senior congressional aide said Tuesday.

"The package includes the creation of 20 new empowerment zones -- a version of the existing EZ without the wage credit -- and two new EZs which include the wage credit," the aide said at a press briefing.
There are currently nine such zones, which provide tax incentives and loans for job creation in the most economically-distressed areas of inner cities and rural areas.

President Clinton earlier this year called for creation of twenty new EZs, but tax bills passed by the House and Senate were silent on the subject. However, House and Senate tax conferees agreed to add the zones during recent talks.
Under the Clinton proposal, businesses within the new zones would have enhanced authority to issue private-activity bonds.
